parameters.content:
## AHTR Assistant

Automates ~45% of the Allied Health Treatment Request cycle while keeping the clinical authorship human:

1. The AHTR renewal alert (from the workers comp workflow) tells the practitioner an AHTR is due.
2. Practitioner opens /form/ahtr-request and types ONLY the clinical sections (diagnosis, treatment plan, goals, outcomes, sessions requested).
3. This workflow merges in everything else — worker, claim, insurer, current approval, full treatment history from the ledger — and emails the assembled AHTR to the insurer (clinic CC'd). Unknown claim numbers are bounced to the admin instead.
4. When the insurer approves, /form/ahtr-approval records the new reference + session count: the profile resets (0 used) and claiming resumes automatically.

Before go-live: set the practitioner name / AHPRA / SIRA numbers in the Assemble AHTR Document node.
